name: Agony, the Knife in the Dark

wiki.title: Item:Agony, the Knife in the Dark

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Keen
effects.tooltip: Keen : Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification .

effects.name: Entropic
effects.tooltip: Entropic : An entropic weapon crackles with a sinister energy that seeks to unmake anything it contacts. When it strikes a target, they take an extra 2 to 12 points of untyped damage.

effects.name: Hemorrhaging
effects.tooltip: Hemorrhaging : This weapon is viciously sharp and will do an additional 2 to 16 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.

effects.name: Disintegration
effects.tooltip: Disintegration : This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them.

effects.name: Improved Deception
effects.tooltip: Improved Deception : This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
